تقترئي (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِئِي (taqtariʔī) /taq.ta.ri.ʔiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
# تُقْتَرَئِي (tuqtaraʔī) /tuq.ta.ra.ʔiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
